name: Tenjou Haya
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c20897]Yukiha[/url]'s step-sister. She takes the place of his mother, and he can't live without her.

She also works part-time as a nurse at Yukiha's school, and as such has a caring and reliable personality. Because of this, she is very popular with both students and staff.

[From [url=https://fragmentsnote-plus.ullucus.com/en/]Switch Site[/url]]
